workflow.title: 8-Step International Standard Workflow
workflow.subtitle: A transparent, closed-loop process guaranteeing security and fairness for both clients and translators.
workflow.step1_desc: Detail your language pair, scope, location, schedule, and allocated budget.
workflow.step2_desc: Qualified translators review your job and send customized bids with clear timelines.
workflow.step3_desc: Compare credentials, certifications, past client reviews, and conduct interviews.
workflow.step4_desc: The client deposits funds securely into the VietTranslate third-party escrow vault.
workflow.step5_desc: The translator delivers the assignment adhering strictly to the agreed standards.
workflow.step6_desc: The client inspects the completed translation or confirms event attendance satisfaction.
workflow.step7_desc: Payment is instantly released to the translator once client approval is confirmed.
workflow.step8_desc: Both parties leave verified feedback to build trust and community reputation.

trust.title: Why 10,000+ Clients Trust VietTranslate
trust.subtitle: We place uncompromising translation fidelity and ironclad financial safety at the core of our platform.
trust.feature1_desc: Funds are only disbursed after you are 100% satisfied with the delivered work.
trust.feature2_desc: All listed profiles undergo identity audits and diploma verification (IELTS, JLPT, HSK, TOPIK, etc.).
trust.feature3_desc: Our dedicated mediation team reviews project logs, audio recordings, and text files within 24 hours.
trust.feature4_desc: Automated non-disclosure agreements protect your corporate data, proprietary files, and private events.

payment_page.title: Escrow Mechanism & Payment Protection | VietTranslate
payment_page.headline: Payment & Transaction Protection (Escrow)
payment_page.intro: VietTranslate operates as a trusted neutral third party, safeguarding financial integrity and service quality for both parties.
payment_page.process_subtitle: A transparent 3-step mechanism that eliminates 100% of non-payment and non-delivery risks.
payment_page.step1_desc: The client deposits the agreed compensation into VietTranslate safe escrow fund upon signing the contract.
payment_page.step2_desc: The system confirms funds are secured. The linguist can work with total focus on providing the highest quality.
payment_page.step3_desc: After the event or translated document meets quality standards, the client approves release and funds transfer instantly.
payment_page.policy_item1_text: Applies if a translator fails to attend an assignment, cancels unexpectedly, or does not deliver agreed files.
payment_page.policy_item2_text: VietTranslate administrators review recordings, time stamps, and deliverables within 24 business hours.
payment_page.policy_item3_text: Over 12,000+ successfully completed transactions without unresolved disputes.
